_comment: Neighborhood tiers. rank drives the shopping rule: you may buy from any neighborhood whose rank is <= your own. Window shopping above is view-only.

neighborhoods.name: Harbour District
neighborhoods.blurb: Where everyone starts. One car, one space, no excuses.

neighborhoods.name: Northridge
neighborhoods.blurb: Room for three. The first real step up.

neighborhoods.name: Eastpoint
neighborhoods.blurb: Premium metal shows up here. Seven spaces to fill.

neighborhoods.name: Westbay
neighborhoods.blurb: Fifteen spaces and access to every shop in the city.

neighborhoods.name: Downtown
neighborhoods.blurb: The top. A hundred spaces and nothing left to prove.

impound._comment: If a player can no longer afford their neighborhood, cars above the new parking limit are impounded until they pay the fee or move back up.
